is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on the whole genome sequence of the Mediterranean fruit fly, Ceratitis capitata (Diptera: Tephritidae), not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: No target insecticide-resistance markers in Anopheles species were genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype data or allele frequencies for Anopheles field populations are provided.

african_field_population.evidence: The study does not analyze field-caught African Anopheles mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study presenting the whole genome sequence and assembly of Ceratitis capitata.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations for Anopheles mosquitoes are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No collection dates for Anopheles field populations are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper does not share sample datasets with Anopheles resistance surveillance projects.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files are not needed because the study is ineligible.

assessment.summary: This study reports the genome assembly and annotation of the Mediterranean fruit fly, Ceratitis capitata. It does not study Anopheles mosquitoes or report target marker frequencies for malaria vectors.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report genotype data for African field populations.
